Third-party libraries in this directory
=======================================

drevo's Web UI uses the JavaScript libraries below. They are redistributed
unmodified inside every copy of drevo-server and served under /ui/vendor/.
Each is released under the MIT License or the ISC License, as the table says;
its copyright notice follows, and the permission notices at the end of this
file apply to the libraries under that licence.

File                  Package                 Licence  Source
--------------------  ----------------------  -------  ------------------------------------------------
cytoscape.min.js      cytoscape 3.30.2        MIT      https://github.com/cytoscape/cytoscape.js
layout-base.js        layout-base 2.0.1       MIT      https://github.com/iVis-at-Bilkent/layout-base
cose-base.js          cose-base 2.2.0         MIT      https://github.com/iVis-at-Bilkent/cose-base
cytoscape-fcose.js    cytoscape-fcose 2.2.0   MIT      https://github.com/iVis-at-Bilkent/cytoscape.js-fcose
cola.min.js           webcola 3.4.0           MIT      https://github.com/tgdwyer/WebCola
cytoscape-cola.js     cytoscape-cola 2.5.1    MIT      https://github.com/cytoscape/cytoscape.js-cola
d3-force.min.js       d3-force 3.0.0          ISC      https://github.com/d3/d3-force
d3-quadtree.min.js    d3-quadtree 3.0.1       ISC      https://github.com/d3/d3-quadtree
d3-dispatch.min.js    d3-dispatch 3.0.1       ISC      https://github.com/d3/d3-dispatch
d3-timer.min.js       d3-timer 3.0.1          ISC      https://github.com/d3/d3-timer
